Hi all, I wanted to let you know about my next potential project, Perfect PRISM. It's a standalone, short futuristic game about two imperfect beings expected to be perfect  - an android and a celebrity idol - who fall in love. It'd be my first solo visual novel game and a vast departure from my MDSOA work, especially with the visual art in-game which features simple, comic-style 2D art, but if you enjoyed MDSOA, you might like to check it out!

notes.title: Aeon Dream Mini Update: August 25th
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11881867/a7cd16ad98b1f50d18d4a3598639970c81dfefce.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone! 

Time for an update! Some good news, some not so good news. So let’s get right to it: 

[b]Mystic Destinies: Serendipity of Aeons Deluxe Edition:[/b]

Unfortunately, the Mystic Library won’t be included in the MDSOA Deluxe version upon release. We lost our server that contained our internal wiki some time ago, and despite working diligently to get it back, we were informed by the provider that everything was deleted :(

It was a tough loss for us, but we’ve begun anew with a different service and have already started working on rewriting all of the lost data, but we lost two years worth of world building and data, so, unfortunately, that will take some time to do.

Because of the immense amount of missing information, we can’t give a precise estimate on when it will be completed, but you should be able to expect an update sometime in 2018. As soon as everything is rewritten, we will update the Mystic Library as an update. This update will be completely free to all owners of the Deluxe version!

[b]Additional updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] The MDSOA artbook is almost complete!
[*] We hope to have the Deluxe Version out in very early September, as nearly all the creative work is completed.
[*] We’re doing our best to have Mystic Destinies: Echoes out by the end of September, so we’ll continue working hard![/list]

[i]If you are a backer, you will receive additional updates about your rewards through Kickstarter or if you are a Paypal backer, through Paypal. [/i]

Thank you for your understanding and support, everyone!

notes.title: Tatsuya's Route is Available; Steam Release Delayed
notes.notes:
Hello all, we are here with some disappointing news.

Last night there was a last minute issue that pushed the release a little later and we fell outside of Valve's allowed time to release - which is only during weekdays. As a new developer, we were not aware of this rule.

We have decided to release a version for purchase on Itch.io. People who want to play the game on Steam will need to wait until offices open on Monday at 9 am PDT to play the game. 

Thank you for your patience and we’re terribly sorry for the inconvenience. We all worked very hard up to the last minute and the game was completed on time. We lost so much sleep working that half of the team ended up passing out afterward and not hearing of the technical issues till morning, which is why we were unable to give this update sooner. 

We’re all extremely disappointed for the delay, but for those who can’t wait - you'll be able to play it on Itch, and for those who are deciding to wait till Monday, please accept our deepest apologies for the mix-up and enjoy the 20% off launch sale on both Itch now and Steam when it launches.

[url=http://starmaidengames.tumblr.com/post/144706010879/dont-want-to-wait-for-the-steam-release-on] Check it out here! [/url]

Bonus: Tatsuya's full first chapter is now available on Steam thanks to the update!

notes.title: Game update, extra content, and epilogue coming!
notes.notes:
Hi there everyone! We've been so excited that so many of you enjoyed Shou's route. But we haven't stopped working, so we have some new things to announce.

[h1]Short Story/Comics[/h1]
Due to player demand, we've decided to release extra content for purchase in the form of short stories and possibly comics. This content will be $0.99 or free for [url=https://www.patreon.com/starmaidengames?ty=h] Patreon [/url] supporters, but will NOT be necessary to understanding or enjoying the character's routes. This is simply extra insight into the characters while we work on developing the game over the course of the next year for players who don't want to wait.

Our first story is a short story from Hikaru's POV and focuses on his meeting Tatsuya and Shinji. [url=https://gumroad.com/l/ugvU]Read more about it here.[/url]

[h1]Shou's Epilogue[/h1]
Shou will have a purchasable epilogue that takes place a few months after his route's end. You will get to see the main character's family and there's plenty of new sprites and a planned CG to behold! (Here's a little secret: It will also help to lead into our potential, unofficially unanounced sequel to the game if we're able to do one!). The price is tentatively set at $1.99. 

[h1]Game Update[/h1]
And last but definitely not least, we will be updating Shou's Main Story with some fixes and new content in the form of additional sprites. The sprites to be added are:
- The Dark Phoenix girl.
- Chisaki Yukimura.
- Matsuda 

We're going to do our best to release the game updates and Shou's epilogue around the same time, so please look forward to that in March!
